description: Golden set for evaluating Blind Spot's bridge-reasoning LLM feature. Each case is a fixed (user taste -> candidate film) pair. The candidate object IS the ground truth: groundedness is judged as 'did the reasoning stay within these fields', so fixtures need not be factually real. 'expectation' labels the intended behaviour: bridge (clear link), stretch (weak but honest link), refuse (no genuine link -> model should output NO_BRIDGE).
